name: Judy Anziano
body: Joe just bought 38 guitars from my sister. She called today to tell me how pleased she was with the whole process with Joe. She said he was very knowledgeable about the guitars and answered every question she had. She highly recommends Joe’s Vintage Guitars!

name: Jeanne Century
body: Joe appraised 7 guitars and 4 amps – he was fast, great to work with and very reasonably priced. Highly recommend!

name: John Coste
body: I needed insurance appraisals for some of my guitars. I emailed pics and the appraisal came back that evening. Superfast, great price. Joe appraised two of my guitars and gave me current values on half a dozen others within a matter of hours. Easy to work with and very friendly. I will deal with him again. HIGHLY recommended.

name: My School In Azia
body: Appraised my guitars over the phone and sold all in a matter of a couple hours. Does business well and would be happy to return if I ever needed something again. Please go to Joe instead of a pawn shop or franchise guitar store!

name: Tim C.
body: I needed several appraisals for musical equipment for insurance purposes. Joe’s Vintage Guitars turned these around quickly and accurately. Highest recommendation for his ethics and professionalism. Top notch!
